name: token-reduction-advisor
description: Ask-first drafts of an ordered context-token reduction plan from a footprint report. Plan-only; does not edit files.

inputs.name: planning-consent
inputs.description: True only when the user consented to reduction planning.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: reduction-plan
outputs.description: Markdown reduction plan; empty when consent is missing.

outputs.name: blocking-questions
outputs.description: Markdown list of blocking questions; empty when none.
